During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the exclusive [[Manarai]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served raw '''Wroonian flycatcher filet'''.

==History==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], raw [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] [[flycatcher]] filet was an appetizer in a [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] meal served to [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Fendrilon Koozar]], by which Koozar was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]]. It was prepared by [[Master Chef|master chef]] [[Tavvar Va'ran]], the second-best [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SES" />
